issues.legal_issue: Whether a transaction involving development rights constitutes a transfer of stock-in-trade or a transfer of a capital asset, based on the relevant factors including the frequency and volume of transactions and the nature of the transactions over time.
Whether a receipt recorded in the recipient’s books must be treated as income unless the recipient establishes that the amount was refunded or returned.
Whether a differential amount arising from a reduction in the stated sale consideration must be assessed as capital gain or business income in the relevant assessment year.
Whether section 50C of the Income Tax Act applies to a transfer of development rights held as stock-in-trade rather than as a capital asset.
